articles.title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
articles.description: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
articles.description: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.

articles.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
articles.description: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

articles.title: Nvidia leads tech sell-off as Huang comeback rally fizzles and AI concerns return
articles.description: Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell as investors weighed AI spending, inflation and higher-rate risks.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.description: Kalshi traders have cut the odds of OpenAI confirming an IPO before June 2027, as AI stocks and related markets have weakened.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls Further as Inflation, Trump Tariffs and AI Selloff Rattle Markets
articles.description: Bitcoin fell below $58,000 as stronger U.S. growth, accelerating inflation and proposed tariffs coincided with a renewed AI stock selloff and bets on higher interest rates in December and beyond.

articles.title: There are 5,100 newly minted Anthropic millionaires—here’s all the stuff they don’t tell you about when you suddenly get rich
articles.description: Anthropic’s IPO made about 5,100 employees paper millionaires. Experts explain the risks of sudden wealth.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield slides despite sticky inflation data as investors buy bonds for protection
articles.description: Bond yields moved lower Wednesday as investors fled to bonds for protection amid sticky inflation data.

articles.title: Even the price of toys is on the rise. How Americans are scaling back holiday plans
articles.description: U.S. consumers face higher food, travel and gift costs in 2026 as inflation and Iran-war energy shocks pressure holiday budgets.

articles.title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
articles.description: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank.

articles.title: Anthropic's stock has been a clunker post-IPO. Why that matters for the AI trade
articles.description: Shares of Anthropic are trading below their IPO price, creating an overhang on other artificial intelligence names.

articles.title: U.S. proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU
articles.description: The new levies seek to counter foreign trade practices deemed unfair, discriminatory or burdensome to U.S. commerce.

articles.title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
articles.description: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

articles.title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
articles.description: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

articles.title: Investors led by U.S. billionaire Todd Boehly to buy Lukoil's oil and gas assets outside Russia, sources say
articles.description: The U.S. International Development Finance Corporation and Catena Investments, based in the United Arab Emirates, are also parties to the deal, the sources said.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
articles.description: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. Phillip Lord of Bitcoin Japan explains how yen funding conditions reach bitcoin, and the shareholder test Japanese companies' bitcoin treasury strategies should have to pass.

articles.title: Saudi national charged in OpenAI bugging to be released on $1 million bond
articles.description: Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at OpenAI's headquarters.

articles.title: Kalshi traders say the odds of states imposing data center moratoriums is more likely than not
articles.description: After Democrats swept Congress and key governor races, Kalshi traders lowered the odds that at least four states would pause data center build-out this year.

articles.title: Wealthy investors seek tax savings from municipal bonds as yields remain elevated
articles.description: Done right, bonds can be used to reduce taxes rather than defer them.

articles.title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe
articles.description: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange said its trading systems were not breached, but stolen customer records could already be being used in future scams.
